name: Files (Nautilus) and file managers

1.notes: Every file manager implements it: reveal a file, open a folder, open properties.

1.how: gio open <path> | gio trash <path> | gio info | gio mount | gio list; xdg-open <path>
1.notes: The file operations themselves never need the file manager; the agent's own file tools plus gio cover everything, with the trash instead of rm.

3.how: Nautilus (GTK4) exposes the file list as a table/grid with file names; Dolphin (Qt) likewise.
3.notes: Only needed to select things for the user to see.

capabilities.name: reveal
capabilities.run: busctl --user call org.freedesktop.FileManager1 /org/freedesktop/FileManager1 org.freedesktop.FileManager1 ShowItems ass 1 'file://{path}' ''

quirks: Never delete with rm; maus file trash is reversible.
